packageRules.description: Everything in package.json and composer.json is development tooling, and neither file reaches wordpress.org, so version-bump.yml ignores them: these merges publish nothing. The Tests workflow rebuilds the admin CSS, so a Tailwind bump that would change shipped CSS fails and stays open. No required checks on main (the release job pushes straight to it), so Renovate itself waits for green checks: platformAutomerge is off.
